title: Can These Bones Live?
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The prophet stood in a valley
Where old, dry bones were spread;
"Can these bones live?" the Lord asked him,
"Only You know," he said.

[Chorus]
Then breath came in, and they stood up,
Alive, alive, alive!
The Lord brings life where none was seen,
And dry things can revive.

[Verse 2]
"Speak out My words," the Lord said then,
And so the prophet spoke;
A noise! A shaking! Bone to bone,
The quiet valley woke.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Beau planted one small seed and watched,
And nothing seemed to grow;
Then one green curl pushed through the dirt,
Where life was hid below.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Take one slow breath, now breathe it out,
Say thank You for the air;
The Lord who woke the valley up
Is with you everywhere.

[Chorus]
mood: Waking music. It starts almost motionless, one low held cello note and a single slow guitar pulse, a valley before anything stirs. With each verse a little more moves: the guitar picks up a steady walking step, the cello line lifts a note at a time like something standing up. Every chorus is brighter and more awake than the one before, never louder, and the last one stays open and clear, a deep breath taken in the middle of the day.
